course.title: Optics and Waves
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: A massless spring, suspended from a rigid support, carries a mass of 600 gm at its lower end and the system oscillates with a frequency of 6 Hz. If the amplitude is reduced to half its undamped value in 22 sec, calculate (i) the force constant of the spring, (ii) the relaxation time of the system and (iii) its quality factor.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
